The hylis package lives in python/, not at the repo root, and pytest
finds it because conftest.py inserts that directory onto sys.path. A
static analyser never runs conftest.py, so it needs telling separately —
otherwise every `from hylis import ...` shows as unresolved in the editor
while the tests pass perfectly well.
_rmi, _hnsw and _hnswlib are compiled pybind11 extensions (.pyd). The
modules exist and import fine; there is simply no Python source for a
